_comment: One of the twelve plain colours. Every part with a colour takes it as its own -- `red sky` the vault, `red sun` the
star, `red sheep` their wool -- and `red age` all of them at once. Said of the rock, the ground or what is built, it
builds them of red blocks (`#red`: dyed concrete and terracotta, and the natural blocks of the colour); said of the
whole Age, only one Age in ten, so a coloured Age is not a world of concrete. It leans the biomes and what grows
toward those of its colour, by name, since no tag carries a colour but a block's.
